mysql.check_user: SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(u.username, '')) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN COALESCE(u.is_active , -1) = 0 THEN 'inactive' WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(u.password, '')) = 0 THEN 'set' ELSE 'ask' END AS `status` FROM (SELECT :user AS usr) AS target LEFT JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.username) = LOWER(target.usr)
mysql.new_password: UPDATE users SET password = :pass_hash WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(:user)
mysql.login: SELECT u.username, CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(u.password, '')) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS success FROM (SELECT :user AS usr) AS target LEFT JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.username) = LOWER(target.usr) AND u.password = :pass_hash
